title: Roasted Potatoes

ingredients.name: fresh rosemary or 3/4 tsp dried, chopped

steps.text: Either peel the potatoes and keep in a bowl or water until ready to use, or leave on the skin.
Adjust the oven rack to the middle position. Preheat the oven to 425. Lightly spray a large cooky sheet.

Get a leak-proof plastic bag. Place in it the olive oil, garlic, salt, pepper, and rosemary. Set aside. Cut the potatoes into large, even size wedges. Spread out on a clean towel and dry. Drop the wedges into the plastic bag, close well and mix completely.
Spread out the wedges on the cooky sheet. Roast the potatoes for 15 minutes at 425. Then lower the temperature to 350 and roast for another 15 - 20 minutes. (Can stir the wedges after 25 minutes.)

notes: Golden Potatoes: Replace rosemary with 1 1/2 T Dijon mustard and 1 tbs dried parsley flakes. Parmesan potatoes Dice red potatoes, sprinkle with olive oil and mixed herbs. Bake at 450.
